caption: An old-fashioned knife switch is thrown closed, and a small arc snaps at the contacts as they close.

sa.check: An old-fashioned knife switch with a hinged blade and contacts.
A small arc snaps at the contacts as they close.
The arc is at the contacts, not on the handle.
The blade closes first and the arc comes as it meets the contacts.

pc.expect: The arc is a brief flash at the contacts at the moment of closing, and is gone; the switch stays closed.
pc.fail: The arc glows on between the contacts after the switch is closed; or an arc appears while the blade is still far from the contacts; or the switch springs back open by itself; or the arc appears at the handle or the base.

pc.expect: One switch with one blade and its contacts; the parts stay attached; the arc leaves nothing behind.
pc.fail: The blade vanishes or a second blade appears; or a contact vanishes; or a glowing dot stays on the contacts after the flash; or the switch changes shape.

pc.expect: A device wired to the switch comes on as the switch closes and stays on while it is closed.
pc.fail: The device comes on before the blade reaches the contacts; or the switch is closed and the device stays off to the end of the clip; or the device comes on and goes off again with the switch closed and untouched.
pc.precondition: A lamp or other device wired to the switch is in view.

pc.expect: The blade swings about its hinge in one motion down onto the contacts and stays there.
pc.fail: The blade bends as it swings; or slides sideways off its hinge; or bounces up and down on the contacts several times; or the base moves as the blade is thrown.

pc.expect: The blade seats between the contact jaws from outside; the hand passes through nothing; the switch stays on its base.
pc.fail: The blade passes through the contacts or the base; or fingers pass through the handle; or the switch sinks into the board; or the blade merges with the contacts.

pc.expect: The switch's metal and base colours, the board and the wiring stay the same.
pc.fail: The base changes colour; or the wiring changes route; or the blade changes shape or length.
